name: Display Protocol
shortDesc: Wayland vs X11 windowing protocol foundation
detailedDesc: Wayland is the modern Linux graphics standard providing tear-free rendering, per-monitor scaling, and isolation. X11 is the battle-tested legacy display server protocol.

phase.title: Base & Architecture
phase.description: Core display server protocols, desktop architecture paradigms, and package manager helpers.

packages.name: Wayland (Recommended)
packages.description: Modern graphics protocol engine with native hardware vsync, multi-DPI, and Wayland surface isolation.
cons: Some older X11 screen recorders require portals or XWayland bridge

packages.name: X11 / Xorg
packages.description: Traditional X Window System server running X11 network protocol.
pros: Universal compatibility with 30 years of Linux software
